notes: Sheet is north-up. Gilbert Av (100 ft, block lines e.g. 590/951 at y 1200) runs NNE across the upper left; E 6th (50 ft) runs from the bottom NNW and merges into Gilbert at the triangle block whose apex is (735,2010); north of the apex E 6th's east line (lots 815 etc.) meets Gilbert's east line at (865,1555). The N-S street at x~2010 is printed 'ELSINORE (RUSSELL)' (Elsinore, formerly Russell; key map prints RUSSELL; sheet 144 prints RUSSELL ST.): named Elsinore Street (no suffix printed) on both 143 and 144 so the shared point ties. It runs from the Eden Park edge at the top (west line continues off the top, so no end recorded) to East Court Street at the bottom. Ida (50 ft, x 2802-2972, pipe 2888) runs the full height; from y~3040 southward it is the IDA bridge (25 ft deck, rails x~2848/2938) that passes OVER East Court Street, so the Ida/East Court crossing (centrelines at about (2890,4081)) is grade-separated and NOT recorded. Paradrome (50 ft, block lines 2202/2382) runs east from Ida past Elgin Pl to sheet 129. ELGIN PL. (EDEN PARK CT.) (60 ft) runs Paradrome to East Court; only its west side is on this sheet. East Court Street (60 ft) runs ENE along the bottom right from Elsinore under the Ida bridge to Elgin Pl and on to sheet 129. The 10 ft alley at x~2451 is printed 'PRIVATE ALLEY' (listed with empty name); it runs from the Eden Park edge (y 425) to East Court. An unlabelled ~15 ft strip with lot lines on both sides runs from (1340,1455) to (1540,4040) between the E 6th lots and the Elsinore lots; it touches no street and is not recorded. Top band (y<425) is Eden Park (open). Scale ~3.39 px/ft.
